thread:
taylor: quick sync 1 MIG-1200 scheduled 00:00-06:00 UTC. staging canary showed intermittent 2-3min row locks during the backfill. thinking we should pin a mitigated worker build for the midnight window.
ben: agree. propose MIG-1200-v1a with BACKFILL_PARALLEL=2 and BATCH_SIZE=250. no schema changes.
anya: add deploybot tourniquet: pause_on_lock_threshold=3/5m and auto-notify #eng-oncall. rollback criteria: any single lock > 300s or >30% error increase.
deploybot: MIG-1200 scheduled. Current status: PENDING. Tourniquet rule available. Will auto-pause if lock threshold breached.
taylor: CI artifacts ready for v1a: https://ci/artifacts/1200/v1a. tests: migration-unit, backfill-sim. ci-bot, link run id?
ci-bot: artifacts & run_id attached: run-1200-20260325-01. backfill-sim logs: https://ci/logs/1200/v1a
ben: I will update infra/deploy/configs/migrations.json to add pinned_version: "MIG-1200-v1a" for 00:00-06:00 UTC and include release note: "reduced parallelism to avoid row lock contention"
anya: ops checklist:
1) Deploy pinned v1a to 3 canary shards
2) Monitor lockwatch, p99 latency, and replica lag for 30m
3) If tourniquet fires or rollback criteria met -> HOLD + revert pin -> notify eng-releases and eng-oncall
4) If stable for 30m -> continue phased rollout and unpin at 06:00
taylor: deploying to canary now. pausing high-concurrency backfill jobs on prod-canary group.
deploybot: Canary rollout started for MIG-1200-v1a -> shards=3. Enforcing tourniquet.
ben: initial 20m check: no locks >60s, p99 within baseline. keeping pin until 06:00.
anya: filed follow-up item: expand backfill-sim to include mixed ALTER+UPDATE workloads and higher concurrency.
ci-bot: reminder: attach run_id to release notes and audit log.
taylor: added run_id to release notes and infra tags. closing thread unless regressions appear.
